asr.full_text: I love you Oh please don't make me feel bad Do you need any help? I love you I am happy hearing this from you Say I love you I am honestly speaking, I love you Are we getting married? We should never be together after doing marriage You're right. I love you Can we go out together? I don't have to be close to meet that girl, just let me know So, you've heard that the Google assistant has given Tamil Voice support So, you've heard them speak English and Tamil and also have Tamil Voice support So, today I want to go and see the Tamil voice options in this video, you can see how to set tamil voice on your google assistants and also how to look forwarded what are comments provided but for now, see this video fully you might not get that tamil voice by following what I did so if you follow I will explain why a good Tamil voice is created after watching this video and watching what other comments he makes in the comment section don't forget to subscribe as well, and press the Bell icon now let's move to the video Google has been giving Tamil Support for every single day recently the Tamil creators have offered to do Monetisation for each content that is what Google for Tamil have just shown us Let us see the Voice Support from Google assistants So I'll first see how to set this First see, Does Google assistant is there in your mobile to check this, just need to go to your main google app, then go to playstore if your installed and press install if it works that we will get a new profile go to language option and choose the language select the language the language will get added the second step is in mobile settings there will be system option there will be language and input option add the language in between and then add the language to the selected language give the 1st option say you have Tamil and English this should make your phone more Tamil you can change it to English Second thing is whether It has tamil or English You could change you phone is tamil So it may change to an english After that we can control our google assistant through voice There are lot of funny comment Let's like those funny comments What is you name? I didn't say before I am your google assistant Vlokum How about me? Not yet. I am your Google Assistant. Hi What is my name? My name is just your name Well, you ate.. Yes, I ate.. In case, you don't need your resume, do you know that I am looking for a help, don't you? How is your age? It will change as per the new generations Google was first founded in 1998. But was established in 2016. Give me a good joke! Look it's all gone if you cut the tree! Then it will turn into a tree! Tell me a story! In the morning, a crow got thirsty, How can we drink? As per the assistant's advice, I drank a lot of water and drank a lot of water. Do you like me? What doubts do you have? What do you like and how much do you like me? More than that, I like you. Do you love me? I'm telling the truth. I love you. Can we get married? There is no such thing that we have to get married. I am the assistant you like. Shall we dance? Play the song Alapuraan Tamil. You have to stay with him. I am staying with Pooja Alamu now. I am playing with him through YouTube. I love you. I am very happy to hear this from you. Do you love me? When I hear you say this, I feel great happiness! Do you love me? I will always be by your side, always with you. I love you Instead of making me proud, do you need any kind of help? Ask someone in a hotel next to you tell me How long is it from Madurai to Bangalore. Now the comments that we saw were very funny. but it was not from Google Assistant I tried it If it was funny and you tried the same comment Tell us in the comments how many of you use Google Assistant if you find any google assistant is funny please comment in comments how many people are using google assistant how many are using in English and how many people are going to change for Tamil comment in the comments this google assistant not working precisely for the mobile some comment is changing and some comments search for them google home or google mini because now I am searching in Google but they've said by Google Home and Mini Tamil has been added they think it would be better but they've said in some updates it would work well in Contour they said in some updates I don't know how many will use this continuously is it in boyfriend or girl friend if you want to talk it to anyone you can talk with people to see because I told it by playing if just you want to talk with Google Assistant in Tamil you can try and see it is a good option. This update just came now, Some words and phrases are not recognized well, They said they need to repair this in the next update. If they can bring Tamil in the next update to all places, It will be much better, I feel. If they can bring Madhura Tamil, Thanjai Tamil etc.. I feel it will be much better. If you think the same, comment me. If this video was useful to you. and bring in thanjai tamil i think it will be more good if you feel like, tell in comment if this video was useful for you please click like button I didn't know of any method to use google in tamil So ,share this video to everyone They will also try google assistant in tamil Let us see in next video like this

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because its primary purpose is an instructional demonstration of Tamil voice support in Google Assistant and its language settings. The speaker acknowledges that some phrases may not be recognized well and may require later updates, rather than promising guaranteed performance. The subscribe prompt is ordinary channel engagement and is not connected to a payment, investment, credential request, or deceptive offer.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The main content is a technology tutorial: the speaker introduces Tamil voice setup, describes a language-settings step, and shows phone settings and an Assistant conversation.
